Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1.  **Text Title:** The text at the top of the panel is **"SAVED HOTBARS"** (located at the bottom center of the main grid area, acting as a label for that section).
2.  **Layout:** **Yes**, there is one single slot separated on the left side (at the bottom-left), while to its right is a wider grid of slots.
3.  **Grid Width:** The bigger grid is **9 columns** wide.
4.  **Item Location:** The leather-like brown item (which looks like **Leather**) is located in the **6th column of the 1st row** (or roughly in the upper-middle right area of the main grid).
